internal.title: Incident Resolved: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Overutilization
internal.body:
At 11:49 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Diagnosis identified that the high p95 latency (1.8s) was correlated with very high CPU utilization (0.98) and the activation of the adHighCpu flag. Other potential causes such as error injection and memory leak were ruled out based on low error rates and minimal memory growth.

The mitigation action was to disable the adHighCpu flag at 12:09 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery of service latency to normal levels (0.12s p95). The incident was resolved and verified shortly after.

Key timeline:
- 11:49:30 Alert received
- 12:09:16 Diagnosis confirmed CPU-related latency
- 12:09:23 Flag disabled
- 12:09:23 Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
